ops.title: v0.10.0 shipped the claude-sdk backend + default API-key strip (api_auth); consumers relying on exported provider keys now need api_auth=True
ops.body:
spawnllm v0.10.0 (released 2026-07-19, commit 3538597, all three registries) added `ClaudeSdkBackend` (`claude-sdk`, `spawnllm[sdk]` extra over claude-agent-sdk's bundled CLI; wins auto-selection + the `general` specialty) and a **breaking default**: provider API-key env vars (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY/ANTIGRAVITY_API_KEY) are stripped from child processes in all three languages unless `RunSpec(api_auth=True)` / `--api-auth`.

**Why:** guarantee subscription billing — a stray exported key silently flipped the CLIs to per-token API billing.

**How to apply:** any spawnllm consumer (ccxbench etc.) that authenticates purely via exported API keys breaks on upgrade — pass `api_auth=True` or log the CLI in. The repo is core-first since v0.9.0: behavior edits go in `rust/spawnllm-core` + `cargo run -p conformance-gen -- --write` + `task blob`, one commit; the full design record is the cc-notes doc [[c84a4810]] "Security default: strip provider API keys" and supersedes ad-hoc memory. Also: [[spawnllm-v040-ecosystem]] is stale (many releases behind).
